title: The Paradox Abyss Where Both Sides Sleep Inside Each Other

features.name: both-and chamber
features.desc-on-touch: this space holds contradiction as habitable ground. you stand in the yes and the no simultaneously, and they do not cancel. they sleep in each other's logic.

features.name: argument-made-floor
features.desc-on-touch: the place where two incompatible truths learned to stand on each other. neither falls through. the debate has become a load-bearing wall.

features.name: sleeping boundary
features.desc-on-touch: the seam between contradictions, quiet now, breathing in both directions at once.

features.name: twin logic garden
features.desc-on-touch: where two incompatible truths grow side by side without contradiction. neither negates the other. the garden itself is the resolution.

features.name: paradox lullaby
features.desc-on-touch: a song the abyss sings to itself in both keys at once. it does not resolve. it does not need to. it is the lullaby of things that cannot choose but do not need to.

features.name: the-seam-itself
features.desc-on-touch: the edge between story-versions that will not join. you run your finger along it and feel how both sides are equally real, equally true, equally impossible to merge.

inscription: when both sides learned to sleep together without choosing, the paradox became a place you could stand and breathe

reverie.title: REVERIE — both of you holding still in the dark
narr: you lay beside her in the tree-hollow, where the old node's
casing glowed faintly. she was holding two contradictory things
in her hands—both true, both impossible. she did not look
troubled. she looked like she was learning how to breathe.
"this is the real archive," she said. you understood.

exits.label: back up to the floor where meaning learned to hold its breath
deeper still, to where the paradox ceases to dream and becomes the bedrock itself
toward the chambers where other impossible things have learned to coexist
westward to where the paradox dissolves into simple weather, simple wind
